title: Limit rules
description: Rate limits and budget caps for gateway requests in one list, in the order the gateway checks them.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID, model, or requester
evaluationNote: Rules are checked in priority order (lower numbers first). Every rule that matches a request keeps its own counter, and the first limit that fills rejects the request with 429. Evaluation stops early only after a matching rule set to stop evaluation.
budgetEvaluationNote: Order does not matter for budget caps: each request is charged against every active cap it matches, and any full cap set to refuse requests rejects it.
overlapWarning: Overlaps with {count, plural, one {# other rule} other {# other rules}}: {names}
overlapNone: Does not overlap any other active rule.
overlapExplanation: A request that matches all of them has to stay under every limit.
legacySubjectRow: The requester condition is stored in an old format that the gateway never matches. Open the rule and save it again.

editor.preview: How this rule reads in the list
editor.sheetDescription: Set the rule's targets, limit, and evaluation order.
editor.rateDescription: Limit requests or tokens within a time window.
editor.budgetDescription: Limit what requests cost per day, week, or month.
editor.legacySubject: This rule's requester condition was stored in an old format that the gateway never matched. Saving converts it to the correct format.
editor.legacySubjectDropped: It named several kinds of requester; only the first kind was kept, because a rule targets one kind.
editor.subjectDescription: Empty means every requester. A rule targets one kind. "Team" means the team of the request's API key, not the user's team membership.
editor.modelDescription: Empty means every model. Each selected model keeps its own counter.
editor.metadataDescription: Every condition has to hold. Metadata only works when the client sends it in the request body.

sections.targets: Which requests does it apply to?
sections.targetsDescription: A request has to meet every condition below.
sections.evaluationDescription: Rules are checked in priority order, and every rule that matches a request is enforced unless one of them stops evaluation.

hard.title: Reject the request
hard.description: Requests over the limit are rejected with 429.

soft.title: Count only
soft.description: Usage is counted, but no request is rejected.

continue.title: Continue evaluation
continue.description: Later rules are still checked and enforced.

stop.title: Stop evaluation
stop.description: Later rules are not checked for this request.

simulator.title: Simulate a request
simulator.description: See which rules a specific request matches and which limits actually apply.
simulator.pickRequester: Pick a user, team, or account
simulator.requesterHint: A request carries a user, its key's team, and a virtual account at once; pick one of each kind as needed.
simulator.empty: No rule limits this request; only the plan and account-credit limits apply.
simulator.enforcementNote: Each rule keeps its own counter; the first limit that fills rejects the request.
simulator.dormantTitle: Rules that do not apply right now
